title: Molecular dynamics insights into combustion mechanisms of JP-10/aluminum nanoparticle composite fuels
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15831-15844
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00051G, Paper
Open Access

Mengfan Si, Shuai Wang, Haiou Wang, Hanhui Jin, Kun Luo, Jianren Fan
The incorporation of metal nanoparticles can enhance the energy release and ignition performance of high-energy-density fuels; however, the effects of particle aggregation and sedimentation mechanisms on combustion remain insufficiently understood.
